## VMC Ubbink Ubiflux Vigor — v1.2.3

Patch release fixing recovery after TCP connection failures in Direct mode.

### Fixes
- After a poll fails with a connection error such as `Connection reset by peer` or `Broken pipe`, the integration closes the failed connection, reconnects, and retries the full poll once.
- If recovery fails, the integration reports the error and allows subsequent polls to try again. Successful recovery refreshes the sensor cache.
- Recovery runs under the existing connection lock. Per-register error handling, write operations, and Server mode retain their existing behavior.

Thanks to the reporter for providing and testing the reconnect approach on a Ubbink Ubiflux W325 with an RS485-to-Ethernet gateway.

Issue: [#28](https://github.com/dimgen/homeassistant-vmc-ubbink/issues/28). Fix: [#29](https://github.com/dimgen/homeassistant-vmc-ubbink/pull/29).

### Upgrade
Update to v1.2.3 through HACS and restart Home Assistant to load the updated integration. No configuration changes are required.
